label: FP
reason: User input from HTTP headers flows to the response writer, but the code explicitly sanitizes the input using ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML() before rendering. This HTML encoding neutralizes XSS payloads, making the reported vulnerability a False Positive.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from headers (Line 44), processed through URL decoding and appended to a StringBuilder (Lines 47-54), then converted to bytes and eventually passed to ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML() (Lines 106-110) before being printed to the response (Lines 105-111).
